set.body:
Goal: place and stack derived legends by measuring, the way the layout solver already does, instead of hard-coded npc constants.

Evidence: discreteLegends uses originX = 0.82 (or 0.08), nextY = 0.88, and steps nextY by entries*0.055+0.04 (CompilerPhases.scala:558-571); GuideSpec.Legend default origin is npc(0.82,0.88) (Layout.scala:154). discreteLegends takes no LayoutPolicy and never consults TextMetrics, while solver-side sizing (PlotLayout.scala:99-116) does.

Acceptance: derived legend placement/stacking consults TextMetrics for row height and label width; no magic npc constants for entry spacing; deterministic per platform; conformance legend cases still pass; JVM+JS tests. Depends on the platform text metrics issue.
set.title: Graphics: derive legend/guide placement from TextMetrics, not magic constants
